digest.component_or_area: LLM workflow model resolution and ladder escalation
propositions: Pass-1 entry rung resolves to bare Anthropic model IDs rather than class names, causing cross-provider split-brain when configured for non-default providers
Ladder escalation via models_at_or_above returns bare Anthropic IDs that infer back to provider anthropic, silently switching providers on escalation in non-Anthropic deployments
Model ladder entries must be expressed as reserved class names (trivial, standard, frontier) and resolved through class config at runtime, not expressed as literal provider-specific model IDs in YAML

Three separate batch-runner and orchestrator call sites independently copy model_ladder[0] directly to cfg.model without class resolution, requiring wired integration through resolve_model_string at each site

sizing.MODEL_LADDER serves dual roles (escalation order and P8 context-window budget via substring match) and must remain unchanged with bare names; class resolution must map rungs post-lookup rather than replace table entries
config.resolve_model must import model_classes lazily inside function body to avoid circular dependency that model_classes module-level imports forbid
